verses.tl: Baraa'atun mina Allaahi wa rasoolihi ilal-ladheena aahadttum minal-mushrikeen
Faseehoo fil-ardi arba'ata ashhurin wa'lamoo annakum ghayru mu'jizee Allaahi wa annallaaha mukhzil-kaafireen

Wa adhaanun mina Allaahi wa rasoolihi ilan-naasi yawmal-hajjil-akbari annallaaha baree'un minal-mushrikeena wa rasooluhu fa-in tubtum fahuwa khayrun lakum wa in tawallaytum fa'lamoo annakum ghayru mu'jizee Allaahi wa bashshiril-ladheena kafaroo bi-adhaabin aleem
Illal-ladheena aahadttum minal-mushrikeena thumma lam yanqusookum shay'an wa lam yuzaahiroo alaykum ahadan fa-atimmoo ilayhim ahdahum ilaa muddatihim innallaaha yuhibbul-muttaqeen

Fa-idhaa insalakhal-ashhurul-hurumu faqtulul-mushrikeena haythu wajadtumoohum wa khudhoohum wahsuroohum waaq'udoo lahum kulla marsadin fa-in taaboo wa aqaamus-salaata wa aataw az-zakaata fakhalloo sabeelahum innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem
Wa in ahadun minal-mushrikeena istajaaraka fa-ajirhu hattaa yasma'a kalaama Allaahi thumma ablighhu ma'manahu dhaalika bi-annahum qawmun laa ya'lamoon
Kayfa yakoonu lilmushrikeena ahdun indallaahi wa inda rasoolihi illal-ladheena aahadtum indal-masjidil-haraami famas-taqaamoo lakum fastaqeemoo lahum innallaaha yuhibbul-muttaqeen
Kayfa wa in yazharoo alaykum laa yarquboo feekum illan wa laa dhimmatan yurdoonakum bi-afwaahihim wa ta'baa quloobuhum wa aktharuhum faasiqoon
Ishtaraw bi-aayaati Allaahi thamanan qaleelan fasaddoo an sabeelihi innahum saa'a maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Laa yarquboona fee mu'minin illan wa laa dhimmatan wa ulaa'ika humul-mu'tadoon
Fa-in taaboo wa aqaamus-salaata wa aataw az-zakaata fa-ikhwaanukum fid-deeni wa nufassilul-aayaati liqawmin ya'lamoon
Wa in nakathoo aymaanahum min ba'di ahdihim wa ta'anoo fee deenikum faqaatiloo a'immatal-kufri innahum laa aymaana lahum la-allahum yantahoon
Alaa tuqaatiloona qawman nakathoo aymaanahum wa hammoo bi-ikhraajir-rasooli wa hum bada'ookum awwala marratin atakhshawnahum fa-Allaahu ahaqqu an takhshawhu in kuntum mu'mineen
Qaatiloohum yu'adhdhibhumu Allaahu bi-aydeekum wa yukhzihim wa yansurkum alayhim wa yashfi sudoora qawmin mu'mineen
Wa yudhhib ghayza quloobihim wa yatoobu Allaahu alaa man yashaa'u Wallaahu aleemun hakeem
Am hasibtum an tutrakoo wa lammaa ya'lami Allaahul-ladheena jaahadoo minkum wa lam yattakhidhoo min doonillaahi wa laa rasoolihi wa lal-mu'mineena waleejatan Wallaahu khabeerun bimaa ta'maloon
Maa kaana lilmushrikeena an ya'muroo masaajida Allaahi shaahideena alaa anfusihim bil-kufri ulaa'ika habitat a'maaluhum wa fin-naari hum khaalidoon
Innamaa ya'muru masaajida Allaahi man aamana Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wa aqaamas-salaata wa aataz-zakaata wa lam yakhsha illaa Allaaha fa-asaa ulaa'ika an yakoonoo minal-muhtadeen
Aja'altum siqaayatal-haajji wa imaaratal-masjidil-haraami kaman aamana Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wa jaahada fee sabeelillaahi laa yastawoona indallaahi Wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Al-ladheena aamanoo wa haajaroo wa jaahadoo fee sabeelillaahi bi-amwaalihim wa anfusihim a'zamu darajatan indallaahi wa ulaa'ika humul-faa'izoon
Yubashshiruhum rabbuhum birahmatin minhu wa ridwaanin wa jannaatin lahum feehaa na'eemun muqeem
Khaalideena feehaa abadan innallaaha indahu ajrun azeem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattakhidhoo aabaa'akum wa ikhwaanakum awliyaa'a inis-tahabbul-kufra alal-eemaani wa man yatawallahum minkum fa-ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon

Qul in kaana aabaa'uukum wa abnaa'uukum wa ikhwaanukum wa azwaajukum wa asheeratukum wa amwaalun iqtaraftumoohaa wa tijaaratun takhshawna kasaadahaa wa masaakinu tardawnahaa ahabba ilaykum mina Allaahi wa rasoolihi wa jihaadin fee sabeelihi fatarabbasoo hattaa ya'tiya Allaahu bi-amrihi Wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-faasiqeen
Laqad nasarakumu Allaahu fee mawaatina katheeratin wa yawma hunaynin idh a'jabatkum kathratukum falam tughni ankum shay'an wa daaqat alaykumul-ardu bimaa rahubat thumma wallaytum mudbireen
Thumma anzala Allaahu sakeenatahu alaa rasoolihi wa alal-mu'mineena wa anzala junoodan lam tarawhaa wa adhdhabal-ladheena kafaroo wa dhaalika jazaa'ul-kaafireen
Thumma yatoobu Allaahu min ba'di dhaalika alaa man yashaa'u Wallaahu ghafoorun Raheem

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo innamal-mushrikoona najasun falaa yaqrabul-masjidal-haraama ba'da aamihim haadhaa wa in khiftum aylatan fasawfa yughneekumu Allaahu min fadlihi in shaa'a innallaaha aleemun hakeem

Qaatilul-ladheena laa yu'minoona Billaahi wa laa bil-yawmil-aakhiri wa laa yuharrimoona maa harrama Allaahu wa rasooluhu wa laa yadeenoona deenal-haqqi minal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba hattaa yu'tul-jizyata an yadin wa hum saaghiroon
Wa qaalatil-yahoodu uzayrun ubnu Allaahi wa qaalatin-nasaaral-maseehu ubnu Allaahi dhaalika qawluhum bi-afwaahihim yudaahi'oona qawlal-ladheena kafaroo min qablu qaatalahumu Allaahu annaa yu'ufakoon
Ittakhadhoo ahbaarahum wa ruhbaanahum arbaaban min doonillaahi wal-maseeha ibna maryama wa maa umiroo illaa liya'budoo ilahan waahidan laa ilaaha illaa huwa subhaanahu ammaa yushrikoon
Yureedoona an yutfi'oo noora Allaahi bi-afwaahihim wa ya'baa Allaahu illaa an yutimma noorahu wa law karihal-kaafiroon
Huwal-ladhee arsala rasoolahu bil-hudaa wa deenil-haqqi liyuzhirahu alad-deeni kullihi wa law karihal-mushrikoon

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo inna katheeran minal-ahbaari war-ruhbaani laya'kuloona amwaalan-naasi bil-baatili wa yasuddoona an sabeelillaahi wal-ladheena yaknizoonadh-dhahaba wal-fiddata wa laa yunfiqoonahaa fee sabeelillaahi fabashshirhum bi-adhaabin aleem
Yawma yuhmaa alayhaa fee naari jahannama fatukwaa bihaa jibaahuhum wa junoobuhum wa zuhooruhum haadhaa maa kanaztum li'nfusikum fadhooqoo maa kuntum taknizoon

Inna iddatash-shuhoori indallaahi ithnaa ashara shahran fee kitaabillaahi yawma khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda minhaa arba'atun hurumun dhaalikad-deenul-qayyimu falaa tazlimoo feehinna anfusakum wa qaatilul-mushrikeena kaaffatan kamaa yuqaatiloonakum kaaffatan wa'lamoo annallaaha ma'al-muttaqeen

Innaman-nasee'u ziyaadatun fil-kufri yudallu bihil-ladheena kafaroo yuhilloonahu aaman wa yuharrimoonahu aaman liyuwaati'oo iddata maa harrama Allaahu fayuhilloo maa harrama Allaahu zuyyina lahum soo'u a'maalihim Wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-kaafireen

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo maa lakum idhaa qeela lakum infiroo fee sabeelillaahi iththaaqaltum ilal-ardi aradeetum bil-hayaatid-dunyaa minal-aakhirati famaa mataa'ul-hayaatid-dunyaa fil-aakhirati illaa qaleel
Illaa tanfiroo yu'adhdhibkum adhaaban aleeman wa yastabdil qawman ghayrakum wa laa tadurroohu shay'an Wallaahu alaa kulli shay'in qadeer

Illaa tansuroohu faqad nasarahu Allaahu idh akhrajahul-ladheena kafaroo thaaniya ithnayni idh humaa fil-ghaari idh yaqoolu lisaahibihi laa tahzan innallaaha ma'anaa fa-anzala Allaahu sakeenatahu alayhi wa ayyadahu bijunoodin lam tarawhaa wa ja'ala kalimatal-ladheena kafarus-suflaa wa kalimatu Allaahi hiyal-ulyaa Wallaahu azeezun hakeem
Infiroo khifaafan wa thiqaalan wa jaahidoo bi-amwaalikum wa anfusikum fee sabeelillaahi dhaalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon

Law kaana aradan qareeban wa safaran qaasidan laattaba'ooka wa laakin ba'udat alayhimush-shuqqatu wa sayahlifoona Billaahi law istata'naa lakharajnaa ma'akum yuhlikoona anfusahum Wallaahu ya'lamu innahum lakaadhiboon
Afaa Allaahu anka lima adhinta lahum hattaa yatabayyana lakal-ladheena sadaqoo wa ta'lamal-kaadhibeen
Laa yasta'dhinukal-ladheena yu'minoona Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri an yujaahidoo bi-amwaalihim wa anfusihim Wallaahu aleemun bil-muttaqeen
Innamaa yasta'dhinukal-ladheena laa yu'minoona Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wartaabat quloobuhum fahum fee raybihim yataraddadoon
Wa law araadul-khurooja la-a'addoo lahu uddatan wa laakin kariha Allaahu inbi'aathahum fathabbatahum wa qeelaq-udoo ma'al-qaa'ideen
Law kharajoo feekum maa zaadookum illaa khabaalan wa la-awda'oo khilaalakum yabghoonakumul-fitnata wa feekum sammaa'oona lahum Wallaahu aleemun biz-zaalimeen
Laqadi ibtaghaw al-fitnata min qablu wa qallaboo lakal-umoora hattaa jaa'al-haqqu wa zahara amru Allaahi wa hum kaarihoon
Wa minhum man yaqoolu i'dhan lee wa laa taftinnee alaa fil-fitnati saqatoo wa inna jahannama lamuheetatun bil-kaafireen
In tusibka hasanatun tasu'uhum wa in tusibka museebatun yaqooloo qad akhadhnaa amranaa min qablu wa yatawallaw wa hum farihoon
Qul lan yuseebanaa illaa maa kataba Allaahu lanaa huwa mawlaanaa wa alaa Allaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
Qul hal tarabbasoona binaa illaa ihdal-husnayayni wa nahnu natarabbasu bikum an yuseebakumu Allaahu bi-adhaabin min indihi aw bi-aydeenaa fatarabbasoo innaa ma'akum mutarabbisoon
Qul anfiqoo taw'an aw karhan lan yutaqabbala minkum innakum kuntum qawman faasiqeen
Wa maa mana'ahum an tuqbala minhum nafaqaatuhum illaa annahum kafaroo Billaahi wa birasoolihi wa laa ya'toonas-salaata illaa wa hum kusaalaa wa laa yunfiqoona illaa wa hum kaarihoon
Falaa tu'jibka amwaaluhum wa laa awlaaduhum innamaa yureedu Allaahu liyu'adhdhibahum bihaa fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wa tazhaqa anfusuhum wa hum kaafiroon
Wa yahlifoona Billaahi innahum laminkum wa maa hum minkum wa laakinnahum qawmun yafraqoon
Law yajidoona malja'an aw maghaaraatin aw muddakhalan lawallaw ilayhi wa hum yajmahoon
Wa minhum man yalmizuka fis-sadaqaati fa-in u'too minhaa radoo wa in lam yu'taw minhaa idhaa hum yaskhatoon
Wa law annahum radoo maa aataahumu Allaahu wa rasooluhu wa qaaloo hasbunaa Allaahu sayu'teenaa Allaahu min fadlihi wa rasooluhu innaa ilaa Allaahi raaghiboon

Innamas-sadaqaatu lilfuqaraa'i wal-masaakeeni wal-aamileena alayhaa wal-mu'uallafati quloobuhum wa fir-riqaabi wal-ghaarimeena wa fee sabeelillaahi waibnis-sabeeli fareedatan mina Allaahi Wallaahu aleemun hakeem

Wa minhumul-ladheena yu'udhoonan-nabiyya wa yaqooloona huwa udhunun qul udhunu khayrin lakum yu'minu Billaahi wa yu'minu lilmu'mineena wa rahmatun lilladheena aamanoo minkum wal-ladheena yu'udhoona rasoola Allaahi lahum adhaabun aleem
Yahlifoona Billaahi lakum liyurdookum Wallaahu wa rasooluhu ahaqqu an yurdoohu in kaanoo mu'mineen
Alam ya'lamoo annahu man yuhaadidi Allaaha wa rasoolahu fa-anna lahu naara jahannama khaalidan feehaa dhaalikal-khizyul-azeem
Yahdharul-munaafiqoona an tunazzala alayhim sooratun tunabbi'uhum bimaa fee quloobihim qulis-tahzi'oo innallaaha mukhrijun maa tahdharoon
Wa la-in sa'altahum layaqoolunna innamaa kunnaa nakhoodu wa nal-abu qul abiaalllahi wa aayaatihi wa rasoolihi kuntum tastahzi'oon
Laa ta'tadhiroo qad kafartum ba'da eemaanikum in na'fu an taa'ifatin minkum nu'adhdhib taa'ifatan bi-annahum kaanoo mujrimeen
Al-munaafiqoona wal-munaafiqaatu ba'duhum min ba'din ya'muroona bil-munkari wa yanhawna anil-ma'roofi wa yaqbidoona aydiyahum nasoo Allaaha fanasiyahum innal-munaafiqeena humul-faasiqoon
Wa-ada Allaahul-munaafiqeena wal-munaafiqaati wal-kuffaara naara jahannama khaalideena feehaa hiya hasbuhum wa la-anahumu Allaahu wa lahum adhaabun muqeem

Kal-ladheena min qablikum kaanoo ashadda minkum quwwatan wa akthara amwaalan wa awlaadan fastamta'oo bikhalaaqihim fastamta'tum bikhalaaqikum kamas-tamta'al-ladheena min qablikum bikhalaaqihim wa khudtum kal-ladhee khaadoo ulaa'ika habitat a'maaluhum fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati wa ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon

Alam ya'tihim naba'ul-ladheena min qablihim qawmi noohin wa aadin wa thamooda wa qawmi ibraaheema wa ashaabi madyana wal-mu'tafikaati atathum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati famaa kaana Allaahu liyazlimahum wa laakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon

Wal-mu'minoona wal-mu'minaatu ba'duhum awliyaa'u ba'din ya'muroona bil-ma'roofi wa yanhawna anil-munkari wa yuqeemoonas-salaata wa yu'toonaz-zakaata wa yutee'oona Allaaha wa rasoolahu ulaa'ika sayarhamuhumu Allaahu innallaaha azeezun hakeem

Wa-ada Allaahul-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa wa masaakina tayyibatan fee jannaati adnin wa ridwaanun mina Allaahi akbaru dhaalika huwal-fawzul-azeem
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu jaahidil-kuffaara wal-munaafiqeena waghluz alayhim wa ma'waahum jahannamu wa bi'sal-maseer

Yahlifoona Billaahi maa qaaloo wa laqad qaaloo kalimatal-kufri wa kafaroo ba'da islaamihim wa hammoo bimaa lam yanaaloo wa maa naqamoo illaa an aghnaahumu Allaahu wa rasooluhu min fadlihi fa-in yatooboo yaku khayran lahum wa in yatawallaw yu'adhdhibhumu Allaahu adhaaban aleeman fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati wa maa lahum fil-ardi min waliyyin wa laa naseer
Wa minhum man aahada Allaaha la-in aataanaa min fadlihi lanassaddaqanna wa lanakoonanna minas-saaliheen
Falammaa aataahum min fadlihi bakhiloo bihi wa tawallaw wa hum mu'ridoon
Fa-a'qabahum nifaaqan fee quloobihim ilaa yawmi yalqawnahu bimaa akhlafoo Allaaha maa wa-adoohu wa bimaa kaanoo yakdhiboon
Alam ya'lamoo annallaaha ya'lamu sirrahum wa najwaahum wa annallaaha allaamul-ghuyoob
Al-ladheena yalmizoonal-muttawwi'eena minal-mu'mineena fis-sadaqaati wal-ladheena laa yajidoona illaa juhdahum fayaskharoona minhum sakhira Allaahu minhum wa lahum adhaabun aleem
Istaghfir lahum aw laa tastaghfir lahum in tastaghfir lahum sab'eena marratan falan yaghfira Allaahu lahum dhaalika bi-annahum kafaroo Billaahi wa rasoolihi Wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-faasiqeen

Farihal-mukhallafoona bimaq'adihim khilaafa rasooli Allaahi wa karihoo an yujaahidoo bi-amwaalihim wa anfusihim fee sabeelillaahi wa qaaloo laa tanfiroo fil-harri qul naaru jahannama ashaddu harran law kaanoo yafqahoon
Falyadhakoo qaleelan wa lyabkoo katheeran jazaa'an bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon

Fa-in raja'aka Allaahu ilaa taa'ifatin minhum fasta'dhanooka lilkhurooji faqul lan takhrujoo ma'iya abadan wa lan tuqaatiloo ma'iya aduwwan innakum radeetum bil-qu'oodi awwala marratin faaq'udoo ma'al-khaalifeen
Wa laa tusalli alaa ahadin minhum maata abadan wa laa taqum alaa qabrihi innahum kafaroo Billaahi wa rasoolihi wa maatoo wa hum faasiqoon
Wa laa tu'jibka amwaaluhum wa awlaaduhum innamaa yureedu Allaahu an yu'adhdhibahum bihaa fid-dunyaa wa tazhaqa anfusuhum wa hum kaafiroon
Wa idhaa unzilat sooratun an aaminoo Billaahi wa jaahidoo ma'a rasoolihi ista'dhanaka ulut-tawli minhum wa qaaloo dharnaa nakun ma'al-qaa'ideen
Radoo bi-an yakoonoo ma'al-khawaalifi wa tubi'a alaa quloobihim fahum laa yafqahoon
Lakinir-rasoolu wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'ahu jaahadoo bi-amwaalihim wa anfusihim wa ulaa'ika lahumul-khayraatu wa ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
A'adda Allaahu lahum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa dhaalikal-fawzul-azeem
Wa jaa'al-mu'adhdhiroona minal-a'raabi liyu'udhana lahum wa qa'adal-ladheena kadhaboo Allaaha wa rasoolahu sayuseebul-ladheena kafaroo minhum adhaabun aleem
Laysa alad-du'afaa'i wa laa alal-mardaa wa laa alal-ladheena laa yajidoona maa yunfiqoona harajun idhaa nasahoo Lillaahi wa rasoolihi maa alal-muhsineena min sabeelin Wallaahu ghafoorun Raheem
Wa laa alal-ladheena idhaa maa atawka litahmilahum qulta laa ajidu maa ahmilukum alayhi tawallaw wa a'yunuhum tafeedu minad-dam'i hazanan allaa yajidoo maa yunfiqoon
Innamas-sabeelu alal-ladheena yasta'dhinoonaka wa hum aghniyaa'u radoo bi-an yakoonoo ma'al-khawaalifi wa taba'a Allaahu alaa quloobihim fahum laa ya'lamoon

Ya'tadhiroona ilaykum idhaa raja'tum ilayhim qul laa ta'tadhiroo lan nu'mina lakum qad nabba'anaa Allaahu min akhbaarikum wa sayaraa Allaahu amalakum wa rasooluhu thumma turaddoona ilaa aalimil-ghaybi wash-shahaadati fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
Sayahlifoona Billaahi lakum idhan-qalabtum ilayhim litu'ridoo anhum fa-a'ridoo anhum innahum rijsun wa ma'waahum jahannamu jazaa'an bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
Yahlifoona lakum litardaw anhum fa-in tardaw anhum fa-innallaaha laa yardaa anil-qawmil-faasiqeen
Al-a'raabu ashaddu kufran wa nifaaqan wa ajdaru allaa ya'lamoo hudooda maa anzala Allaahu alaa rasoolihi Wallaahu aleemun hakeem
Wa minal-a'raabi man yattakhidhu maa yunfiqu maghraman wa yatarabbasu bikumud-dawaa'ira alayhim daa'iratus-saw'i Wallaahu samee'un aleem

Wa minal-a'raabi man yu'minu Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wa yattakhidhu maa yunfiqu qurubaatin indallaahi wa salawaatir-rasooli alaa innahaa qurbatun lahum sayudkhiluhumu Allaahu fee rahmatihi innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem

Was-saabiqoonal-awwaloona minal-muhaajireena wal-ansaari wal-ladheena ittaba'oohum bi-ihsaanin radiya Allaahu anhum wa radoo anhu wa a'adda lahum jannaatin tajree tahtahal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadan dhaalikal-fawzul-azeem
Wa mimman hawlakum minal-a'raabi munaafiqoona wa min ahlil-madeenati maradoo alan-nifaaqi laa ta'lamuhum nahnu na'lamuhum sanu'adhdhibuhum marratayni thumma yuraddoona ilaa adhaabin azeem
Wa aakharoona i'tarafoo bidhunoobihim khalatoo amalan saalihan wa aakhara sayyi'an asaa Allaahu an yatooba alayhim innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem
Khudh min amwaalihim sadaqatan tutahhiruhum wa tuzakkeehim bihaa wa salli alayhim inna salaataka sakanun lahum Wallaahu samee'un aleem
Alam ya'lamoo annallaaha huwa yaqbalut-tawbata an ibaadihi wa ya'khudhus-sadaqaati wa annallaaha huwat-tawwaabur-Raheem
Wa quli-maloo fasayaraa Allaahu amalakum wa rasooluhu wal-mu'minoona wa saturaddoona ilaa aalimil-ghaybi wash-shahaadati fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
Wa aakharoona murjawna li-amri Allaahi immaa yu'adhdhibuhum wa immaa yatoobu alayhim Wallaahu aleemun hakeem

Wal-ladheena ittakhadhoo masjidan diraaran wa kufran wa tafreeqan baynal-mu'mineena wa irsaadan liman haaraba Allaaha wa rasoolahu min qablu wa layahlifunna in aradnaa illal-husnaa Wallaahu yashhadu innahum lakaadhiboon
Laa taqum feehi abadan lamasjidun ussisa alat-taqwaa min awwali yawmin ahaqqu an taqooma feehi feehi rijaalun yuhibboona an yatatahharoo Wallaahu yuhibbul-muttahhireen
Afaman assasa bunyaanahu alaa taqwaa mina Allaahi wa ridwaanin khayrun am man assasa bunyaanahu alaa shafaa jurufin haarin fanhaara bihi fee naari jahannama Wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Laa yazaalu bunyaanuhumul-ladhee banaw reebatan fee quloobihim illaa an taqatta'a quloobuhum Wallaahu aleemun hakeem

Innallaaha ishtaraa minal-mu'mineena anfusahum wa amwaalahum bi-anna lahumul-jannata yuqaatiloona fee sabeelillaahi fayaqtuloona wa yuqtaloona wa'dan alayhi haqqan fit-tawraati wal-injeeli wal-qur'aani wa man awfaa bi-ahdihi mina Allaahi fastabshiroo bibay'ikumul-ladhee baaya'tum bihi wa dhaalika huwal-fawzul-azeem
At-taa'iboonal-aabidoonal-haamidoonas-saa'ihoonar-raaki'oonas-saajidoonal-aamiroona bil-ma'roofi wan-naahoona anil-munkari wal-haafizoona lihudoodi Allaahi wa bashshiril-mu'mineen
Maa kaana lin-nabiyyi wal-ladheena aamanoo an yastaghfiroo lilmushrikeena wa law kaanoo ulee qurbaa min ba'di maa tabayyana lahum annahum ashaabul-jaheem
Wa maa kaanas-tighfaaru ibraaheema li-abeehi illaa an maw'idatin wa-adahaa iyyaahu falammaa tabayyana lahu annahu aduwwun Lillaahi tabarra'a minhu inna ibraaheema la-awwaahun haleem
Wa maa kaana Allaahu liyudilla qawman ba'da idh hadaahum hattaa yubayyina lahum maa yattaqoona innallaaha bikulli shay'in aleem
Innallaaha lahu mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi yuhyee wa yumeetu wa maa lakum min doonillaahi min waliyyin wa laa naseer

Laqad taaba Allaahu alan-nabiyyi wal-muhaajireena wal-ansaaril-ladheena ittaba'oohu fee saa'atil-usrati min ba'di maa kaada yazeeghu quloobu fareeqin minhum thumma taaba alayhim innahu bihim ra'oofun Raheem

Wa alath-thalaathatil-ladheena khullifoo hattaa idhaa daaqat alayhimul-ardu bimaa rahubat wa daaqat alayhim anfusuhum wa zannoo an laa malja'a mina Allaahi illaa ilayhi thumma taaba alayhim liyatooboo innallaaha huwat-tawwaabur-Raheem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo ittaqoo Allaaha wa koonoo ma'as-saadiqeen

Maa kaana li'hlil-madeenati wa man hawlahum minal-a'raabi an yatakhallafoo an rasooli Allaahi wa laa yarghaboo bi-anfusihim an nafsihi dhaalika bi-annahum laa yuseebuhum zama'un wa laa nasabun wa laa makhmasatun fee sabeelillaahi wa laa yata'oona mawti'an yagheezul-kuffaara wa laa yanaaloona min aduwwin naylan illaa kutiba lahum bihi amalun saalihun innallaaha laa yudee'u ajral-muhsineen
Wa laa yunfiqoona nafaqatan sagheeratan wa laa kabeeratan wa laa yaqta'oona wadeean illaa kutiba lahum liyajziyahumu Allaahu ahsana maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Wa maa kaanal-mu'minoona liyanfiroo kaaffatan falawlaa nafara min kulli firqatin minhum taa'ifatun liyatafaqqahoo fid-deeni wa liyundhiroo qawmahum idhaa raja'oo ilayhim la-allahum yahdharoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo qaatilul-ladheena yaloonakum minal-kuffaari wa lyajidoo feekum ghilzatan wa'lamoo annallaaha ma'al-muttaqeen
Wa idhaa maa unzilat sooratun faminhum man yaqoolu ayyukum zaadathu haadhihi eemaanan fa-ammal-ladheena aamanoo fazaadathum eemaanan wa hum yastabshiroon
Wa ammal-ladheena fee quloobihim maradun fazaadathum rijsan ilaa rijsihim wa maatoo wa hum kaafiroon
Awalaa yarawna annahum yuftanoona fee kulli aamin marratan aw marratayni thumma laa yatooboona wa laa hum yadhdhakkaroon
Wa idhaa maa unzilat sooratun nazara ba'duhum ilaa ba'din hal yaraakum min ahadin thumma insarafoo sarafa Allaahu quloobahum bi-annahum qawmun laa yafqahoon
Laqad jaa'akum rasoolun min anfusikum azeezun alayhi maa anittum hareesun alaykum bil-mu'mineena ra'oofun Raheem
Fa-in tawallaw faqul hasbee Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huwa alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul-arshil-azeem
